1. Launch the application and navigate to AI Tools > Generate Object.
2. Select any photo and tap Use This Image.
3. Tap or paint one area of the image.
4. Paint an additional area of the image.
5. Verify that the second selection is added to the existing selection.
6. Tap the Brush Size button.
7. Verify that 8px, 16px, and 24px brush size options are displayed.
8. Select any brush size.
9. Verify that the selected brush size is applied and the brush size menu remains open.
10. Tap outside the brush size menu.
11. Verify that the menu closes without activating another control or drawing on the image.
12. Enter a valid prompt in the description text box.
13. Tap Generate.
14. Verify that the Generating Loader is displayed.
15. Repeat the generation flow with the device internet connection disabled.
16. Tap Generate.
17. Verify that the No Internet popup is displayed with an OK button.
18. Tap OK.
19. Enable the internet connection.
20. Repeat the generation flow and simulate an API generation failure.
21. Verify that the Generation Failed screen is displayed with the message “Something went wrong. Please try again.”
22. Tap Try Again.
23. Verify that generation starts again and the Generating Loader is displayed.
expected:
Multiple taps/brush strokes are cumulative.
Brush sizes 8px, 16px, and 24px are available.
Selecting a brush size applies it while keeping the menu open.
Tapping outside the menu closes it without performing another action.
Generate displays the Generating Loader.
No Internet displays the No Internet popup with OK.
API failure displays the Generation Failed screen with the specified message.
Try Again starts generation again.

module: AI Tools >Generate Object – Generated Results
description: Verify generated result options, result switching, Generate New and Cancel behavior.
steps:
1. Launch the application and navigate to AI Tools > Generate Object.
2. Select any photo and tap Use This Image.
3. Paint an area where the object should be generated.
4. Enter a valid object generation prompt.
5. Tap Generate.
6. Wait for the generation to complete.
7. Verify that 2 generated image results are displayed.
8. Verify that Option 1 is selected by default.
9. Tap the second result thumbnail.
10. Verify that the selected result is displayed as the main preview.
11. Tap Generate New.
12. Verify that the Generating Loader is displayed.
13. Wait for generation to complete.
14. Verify that 2 new generated image options are displayed.
15. Tap Cancel.
16. Verify that the Unsaved Changes popup is displayed with Stay and Exit without Saving options.
17. Tap Stay.
18. Verify that the popup closes and the user remains on the result screen.
19. Tap Cancel again.
20. Tap Exit without Saving.
21. Verify that the user is redirected to the AI Tools selection screen.
expected:
Two generated image results are displayed.
Option 1 is selected by default.
Tapping a thumbnail switches the main preview to that result.
Generate New displays the Generating Loader and produces two new options.
Cancel displays the Unsaved Changes popup.
Stay keeps the user on the result screen.
Exit without Saving redirects to the AI Tools selection screen.

module: AI Tools >Generate Object – Print Preview Save, Discard and Print Result
description: Verify Print Preview, Save to Gallery, Do Not Save, popup dismissal, and print output.
steps:
1. Launch the application and navigate to AI Tools > Generate Object.
2. Select any photo and tap Use This Image.
3. Paint an area where the object should be generated.
4. Enter a valid object generation prompt.
5. Tap Generate.
6. Wait for the generated results.
7. Select any generated result and tap Apply.
8. Verify that the Print Preview screen is displayed with the generated image.
9. Tap the Back arrow.
10. Verify that the Save as new photo? popup is displayed with Save to Gallery and Do Not Save options.
11. Tap the Cross icon.
12. Verify that the popup closes and the user remains on the Print Preview screen.
13. Tap the Back arrow again.
14. Tap Save to Gallery.
15. Verify that the generated image is saved to the gallery and the user returns to the previous screen.
16. Repeat the Generate Object flow until the Save as new photo? popup is displayed.
17. Tap Do Not Save.
18. Verify that the generated image is not saved to the gallery and the user returns to the previous screen.
19. Generate another object and tap Apply.
20. Ensure the printer is connected.
21. Send the print command.
22. Verify that the printed output matches the generated image displayed in Print Preview.
expected:
Apply redirects to Print Preview with the generated image.
Back displays Save as new photo? with Save to Gallery and Do Not Save options.
Cross closes the popup and keeps the user on Print Preview.
Save to Gallery saves the generated image and returns to the previous screen.
Do Not Save does not save the image and returns to the previous screen.
The printed output matches the generated image displayed in Print Preview.
